answer: One vote costs a three-tier terrace climb: 90 minutes of timestamped ledger work, an $18 stake locked 30 days, and two strangers countersign a watched session, each risking $12. False countersigns slash both; one tier per 72 hours. Every stamp pins to the atlas: one identity in two sessions burns both and seizes the $24 witness bond. A prism audit re-checks 5% and can slash $30. Faking 5,000 votes needs 7,500 watched hours and $210,000 of stake and witness money at risk: a prism beam splits into colors, and one duplicated session fans out into fraud markers burning the fake terrace.
